description:
Update the validation, gate-checker and invariant references to state that every validation view and built-in validation checker is a selection of one report, and the behaviour that follows.

## Background

- `docs/reference/cli-commands.md` documents `jit validate` (`:3249-3334`) and `jit invariant check` (`:3507-3520`); `docs/reference/worktree-validate.md` documents `jit validate` (`:288` onwards); `docs/reference/gate-presets.md` lists the portable checkers (`:25-105`); `docs/concepts/validation-engine.md` describes where rules run (`:40-80`); `docs/concepts/planning-bracket.md:248` and `docs/how-to/adopt-planning-bracket.md:408-415` describe `--scope`.
- Changed behaviour: `--scope` evaluates rules over the whole repository, restricts findings to the container's bracket scope, and reports an unloadable rule set as the `rules-file` finding instead of failing; per-issue and `--explain` configuration errors narrow to the selected issue's subject or rule; issue and explain views always include `rules-file` and never `enforcement-drift`; the rule view reports `rules-file` for an unloadable rule set; `jit invariant check` fails on an unloadable gate registry; each built-in validation checker reports what `jit validate` reports for its selection, so the label-target checker evaluates rules over the whole repository and the issue checker's configuration errors narrow to the gated issue's subject or rule.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The listed pages describe each view and each built-in validation checker as a selection of the one report, and state the changed behaviour above where each page covers the view.
- [hard] REQ-02: No page under `docs/` describes `--scope` as evaluating rules over the slice alone, or `jit invariant check` as tolerating an unloadable gate registry.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Validation and gate references describe views as report selections
